```yaml
name: Main Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'camel-4.10.x'
      - 'camel-4.14.x'

concurrency:
  group: main-build-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven

      - name: Build with Maven
        run: mvn -B clean install -DskipTests=false -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true -Dcheckstyle.skip=true -Dpmd.skip=true -Dspotbugs.skip=true -Djacoco.skip=true

      - name: Upload Test Results
        if: always()
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          directory: ./target/surefire-reports/
```
